table: One table a plugin's dataset need expects, with its columns. {{table}} and {{columns}} are technical names; keep them.
writes: After a dataset need's name: the plugin writes this dataset.
reads: After a dataset need's name: the plugin only reads this dataset.
expects: Under a dataset need: the tables and columns it expects. {{columns}} is a list of them, technical names.
new: Choice: make a new dataset for this need.
not-now: Choice: leave this read need without a dataset for now.
bound-now: Choice: the dataset the need uses now. {{name}} is its name.
used-before: Choice: a dataset this plugin used before it was uninstalled. {{name}} is its name.
written-by: After a dataset's name in a choice: another plugin writes it. {{name}} is that plugin's name.
does-not-fit: After a dataset's name in a choice: its tables don't fit what the plugin expects, so it can't be chosen.
why: Summary of a collapsed list of the datasets that can't be chosen, and why.
problem: One dataset that can't be chosen: <name> wraps its name ({{name}}, in bold); {{problem}} is why, from the server in English.
install.title: Title of the dialog that installs a plugin and asks which datasets it uses. {{name}} is the plugin's name.
install.cancel: Button that closes the dialog without installing.
load-failed: Error toast when the plugin's dataset needs could not load.
none: Shown when the plugin uses no workspace datasets.
bound: Toast after a need got a dataset. {{need}} is the need's technical name.
unbound: Toast after a read need was left without a dataset. {{need}} is the need's technical name.
change-failed: Error toast when changing a need's dataset failed.
state.bound: Under a need on the plugin's page: the dataset it uses ({{name}}); the read form says it only reads it, the write form that only this plugin writes it.
state.unbound: Under a need without a dataset: the plugin can't reach any data for it.
